privacy_intro: Project Achievers is an independent website. For any question about your data:
privacy_data_accounts: ID, username and avatar of your Steam, Discord, Google, PlayStation, Xbox and Battle.net accounts, plus the list of your WoW characters.
privacy_data_partners: Your account id on a partner site (Lure), when the same Discord, Steam… sign-in proves it is you.
privacy_data_partner_sharing: What a partner site receives: if it is linked to your account and your profile is public, your new achievements are sent to it as they come; if you authorised it (“Sign in with Achievers”), it can read your games and achievements even with a private profile. Never your email, messages or friends. You can unlink the account or remove access at any time in your account.
privacy_data_content: Your guides, comments, votes and reports.
privacy_data_sessions: Your sessions: date of use and browser.
privacy_not_collected_text: No platform passwords, and no player NPSSO tokens. Xbox tokens are encrypted on the server. The only cookies are those for your session, language, theme and the sign-in or profile merge steps, which are strictly necessary for the service.
privacy_rights_text: From your account, you can make your profile private, unlink an account, export your data or permanently delete your account.
rate_limited: Too many requests, try again in a minute.
privacy_translation_text: Public guides and comments are sent to Cloudflare Workers AI to be translated automatically into their readers' language. The translation is stored on the site and deleted along with the original text.
